qs.q: Which of the following is true about necrotizing enterocolitis in newborns?
o: Most often present with abdominal distension
Oral feeds should be continued as tolerated
Abdominal x-rays are usually not contributory
Does not occur in term babies
qs.e: Necrotizing enterocolitis classically presents with feeding intolerance, bloody stools, and prominent abdominal distension. Abdominal radiographs are crucial for diagnosis by showing pneumatosis intestinalis or free air.
